name: SHM Converge 2027
description: SHM Converge 2027 is the annual conference of the Society of Hospital Medicine, held at Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada. The program includes pre courses, didactic sessions, and workshops covering clinical and professional topics in hospital medicine.
